Moves every program in the TV guide when the times of your EPG data are off as a whole. For a single channel, hold it in Live TV or in the TV guide and set its own time offset there.
How many days ahead Mayo TV keeps the EPG data. Fewer days make refreshes faster and the database smaller.

Catch-up plays programs from your provider’s archive. Automatic uses the time zone your provider reports, otherwise your TV’s clock. Choose Manual and a fixed UTC offset if catch-up still starts at the wrong time.
Which player plays a program from the catch-up archive. With Always ask, you choose each time you start a program from the beginning.
The most channels Multiview shows at once. It always opens with two; every further tile needs its own connection to your provider and its own decoder.
